_comment: Korax conformance fixture 05. Retention as a read-side default (§8.2, R22). Accepted log, in id order. `sig`/`board_sig` omitted; the generator fills them from conformance/keys.json. Exercises: a permanent nest and a rotating nest side by side; governance acts surviving a horizon that swallows everything around them; JOB rotating, which is what separates the rotation-exempt set from the seam-exempt set; a nest switching from permanent to rotate mid-log, so the same envelope reads differently at two offsets; and an unparseable horizon, which must hide nothing. Timestamps are spread across days on purpose — a board that takes its cutoff from wall clock instead of log time passes this fixture today and fails it next month, which is the failure this fixture exists to catch.

payload._note: the permanent nest — nothing here ever rotates
the rotating nest — declares a 30-day horizon from first light
